common.title: Third-party Platform Management
common.description: Unified management of third-party logins and open platform credentials.

loginConfig.title: Third-party Login Config
loginConfig.description: Configure OAuth login credentials used by the WEB client for each platform.

alipay.tabDescription: Alipay OAuth credentials for auth login and payment channel authentication
alipay.title: Alipay App Auth Configuration
alipay.description: Manage Alipay OAuth credentials (appId/private key/certs) for auth login to get user identifier (userId) and payment channel authentication.
alipay.usageTip: This configuration serves both: 1) Alipay auth login in third-party login; 2) Channel authentication in payment scenarios (get user identifier for payment).
alipay.confirmSaveContent: Are you sure to save the Alipay App configuration?
alipay.appIdDesc: The appId of the application created on Alipay Open Platform
alipay.authTypeDesc: Public key mode uses Alipay public key, Certificate mode uses three certificates
alipay.privateKeyDesc: App private key (PEM format, required for both public key and certificate mode)
alipay.alipayPublicKeyDesc: Alipay public key (for public key mode, obtained from Alipay Open Platform 'Application Info')
alipay.appCertDesc: App public certificate (for certificate mode, upload .crt file)
alipay.alipayCertDesc: Alipay public certificate (for certificate mode, upload .crt file)
alipay.alipayRootCertDesc: Alipay root certificate (for certificate mode, upload .crt file)

wechatMp.tabDescription: WeChat MP H5 OAuth credentials for WeChat login
wechatMp.title: WeChat Official Account Auth Configuration
wechatMp.description: Manage WeChat MP H5 web authorization credentials (appId/appSecret) to get user openId.
wechatMp.usageTip: This configuration serves WeChat MP H5 web authorization to get user openId.
wechatMp.confirmSaveContent: Are you sure to save the WeChat Official Account configuration?
wechatMp.appIdDesc: WeChat Official Account AppId (obtained from MP Platform 'Settings & Development - Basic Config')
wechatMp.inputAppId: Please enter WeChat MP App ID
wechatMp.appSecretDesc: WeChat Official Account AppSecret (obtained from MP Platform 'Settings & Development - Basic Config')
wechatMp.inputAppSecret: Please enter WeChat MP App Secret
